summary: Shows setting environment at task level (http_proxy), reusing a dict variable for environment, storing proxy settings in group_vars, and setting environment at play level.
questions: How do I set an HTTP proxy for a package install task?
How can I reuse proxy settings across playbooks?
Can I set environment variables for a whole play?

answer_card.title: Setting the remote environment
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.package:
    name: cobbler
    state: present
  environment:
    http_proxy: http://proxy.example.com:8080
```

Reuse via a variable:

```yaml
# group_vars/boston
proxy_env:
  http_proxy: http://proxy.bos.example.com:8080
  https_proxy: http://proxy.bos.example.com:8080
```

`environment: "{{ proxy_env }}"` on a task, or `environment:` at play level.
